Los Angeles, California · eat

Restaurants in Los Angeles for cyclists

Where to eat in Los Angeles the night before a ride and the afternoon after. Nothing fancy. Real food, real portions, places that are open when you need them.

Restaurants in Los Angeles for cyclists, listed

  1. Reddi Chick BBQ

    Barbecue · 225 26th Street #23, Santa Monica, CA 90402

    After the ride, on the Westside: a counter in the Brentwood Country Mart, the corner where Velo Club La Grange's weekday rides (Tue, Wed, Thu and Fri, 6:30 am) leave. Open 10 to 7 every day, so lunch, not breakfast. Barbecue chicken, ribs and baked potatoes, per its site. Seating and bike parking were not on the page.

  2. Pine & Crane Silverlake

    Taiwanese · 1521 Griffith Park Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90026

    The night before, on the east side: noodle soup and rice plates at a counter in Silver Lake, at the Sunset Triangle, on the Griffith Park side of town. Noon to 10, closed Tuesday. No reservations; a group lines up. Some seating outside in the plaza next door, per its site.

  3. Canter's Deli

    Deli · 419 N Fairfax Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90036

    Late, and early: 6 a.m. to 11:30 p.m. Monday to Friday, from 5 a.m. Sunday, all night Saturday, per its site. A big room on Fairfax between the Westside and the east side. Takes a group at any hour. Breakfast all day.

  4. Brent's Deli Northridge

    Deli · 19565 Parthenia Street, Northridge, CA 91324

    After the ride, in the Valley: the Northridge deli in the same neighborhood as the CSUN lot where SFVBC's club ride (Saturdays and Sundays, 8:00 am) leaves. Opens at 8 every day; closes at 8, or 3 on Monday. Outdoor tables and bike parking were not on its page.

  5. Martha's 22nd Street Grill

    Breakfast · 25 22nd St, Hermosa Beach, CA 90254

    After the ride, South Bay: breakfast and lunch on a patio in Hermosa Beach with the sand in view, on the beach path and north of the Redondo Beach start of the Donut Ride (Saturdays, 8:00 am). 7 to 3 every day, per OpenTable and a listing with 2026 reviews. No site of its own; (310) 376-7786.

  6. The Rock Store

    Diner · 30354 Mulholland Highway, Cornell, CA 91301

    On the way, in the mountains: the motorcycle roadhouse on Mulholland Highway, the road the Latigo loop jogs onto at Kanan. Breakfast and lunch on an outside patio, weekends only: 7 to 6 Saturday and Sunday, 9 to 6 Friday, closed Monday to Thursday, per TripAdvisor and a September 2025 local guide. Its own site was dead when we checked. Call (818) 889-1311 before you count on it.

  7. The Donut Man

    Donuts · 915 E Route 66, Glendora, CA 91740

    On the way, in the foothills: the donut shop on Route 66 in Glendora, the town at the bottom of Glendora Mountain Road. Before or after GMR and the Baldy loop. Open 24 hours every day, per a listing; its own site would not load for us. Confirm by phone, (626) 335-9111.
